articleTitle: Three-State Recognition of Corporate Turnaround Using Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: The recognition of corporate turnaround state is necessary for successful turnaround of declining firm. This study applies support vector machine to three-state recognition of corporate turnaround. Based on Chinese listed firms data, the classification models are made and applied to predict. The comparison results of prediction show that the predictive accuracy of support vector machine model is better than that of ordinal logistic model in the three-state turnaround recognition for successful turnaround group and continuous decline group. On overall average predictive accuracy support vector machine is better than ordinal logistic model too.

articleTitle: Research on Media Communication Based on Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: With the continuous development of social media and digital platforms, media communication research is facing new challenges and opportunities. As a powerful deep learning method, graph neural network provides a new perspective and tool for media communication research. This paper, titled “Research on Media Communication Based on Graph Neural Networks, aims to explore the application of graph neural networks in the field of media communication and its impact on communication mode and user behavior. This paper first reviews the history and traditional methods of media communication research, and points out the problems and limitations faced in the era of social media. Then, the basic principles and characteristics of graph neural networks are introduced, including graph structure representation, graph convolutional neural network (GCN) and graph attention network (GAT). Through graph neural network, researchers can better capture the user relationship, information transmission path and propagation effect in media communication, so as to realize the modeling and analysis of complex network environment.

articleTitle: Time Series Classification Based on Intuitionistic Fuzzy Clustering Similarity Measure
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: At present, the method of using conventional distance to calculate the similarity between sequences needs to be further improved. It seems challenging to accurately characterize the shape and trend changes of time series solely based on analyzing and computing the time series data itself. In this paper, fuzzy theory is introduced to analyze time series and reconstruct high-dimensional time series. The reconstructed segmented time series encapsulates the trend changes throughout the entire time span. By defuzzifying the reconstructed segmented time series, it is mapped to the corresponding morphological representation, yielding a representation vector that reflects the morphological shape and trend changes of the time series. Furthermore, the similarity of the new representations is measured in combination with dynamic time warping, and the new representations are classified based on the calculated distances. This paper proposes a classification algorithm based on the intuitionistic fuzzy clustering similarity measure, which measures the variation trend of time series from the perspectives of global approximation and local difference. Experimental validation on real-world datasets demonstrates the effectiveness and high classification accuracy of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Modeling and Prediction of Building Carbon Emission in Jiangsu Province
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: Reducing building carbon emission is an effective strategy for energy conservation and emission reduction, and accurate carbon emission prediction can provide an important reference for formulating emission reduction policies and optimizing low-carbon building design. Based on the historical data of the whole process of building carbon emissions in Jiangsu Province, this paper established a prediction model based on long short term memory networks and predicted the total carbon emissions of Jiangsu Province in 2023. Modeling and forecasting are of great significance for building carbon emission reduction and policy formulation in Jiangsu Province.

articleTitle: Simulation Research of Optical Module Temperature Control Based on BP Neural Network PID Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: In order to avoid the degradation of transmission performance caused by the phenomenon of wavelength drift in the laser of optical module in the high and low temperature environment, TEC temperature control system is generally added to the optical module. The traditional temperature control algorithm is PID control algorithm, the principle is simple and easy to implement, but there are some problems of overcompensation and oscillation. In this paper, a temperature control system based on BP neural network PID algorithm is proposed and simulated by python software. After verification, the BP neural network PID control algorithm proposed in this paper can achieve a temperature control precision less than ±0.2°C, and the adjustment process is stable without vibration, with high performance.

articleTitle: Prediction and Analysis of Table Tennis Movement Trajectory Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence technology, detecting, tracking, analyzing, and predicting the movements of table tennis has become possible. This enables precise identification of the ball's landing point for training table tennis robots. Additionally, it helps athletes better understand their opponents' shot trajectories, react in advance, and adopt suitable tactical strategies, ultimately determining the optimal hitting angle and strength. This paper primarily focuses on analyzing and modeling the player's stroke trajectory and the ball's landing position. The YOLO and SORT algorithms are used to track and detect table tennis movements, facilitating the prediction of movement trajectories and identification of the player's shot paths. Consequently, these findings can be utilized for tactical training.

articleTitle: Spam Sorting Based on Naive Bayes Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: The primary objective of this research is to classify spam, with the aim of mitigating the potential infringement on personal privacy resulting from spam. The categorization of spam messages involves the utilization of the Naive Bayes algorithm, which employs the principles of Bayes' Theorem and conditional independence assumptions to calculate and compare probabilities for classification purposes. The accuracy of spam categorization in the test is 98.3%, achieved by the implementation of Laplace smoothing and logarithmic accumulation techniques. The application of Naive Bayes for spam classification has several advantages, including the reduction of complexity associated with Bayes' Theorem, simplification of the procedure, decreased input requirements, and consistent classification accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of Physical Education Teaching System Based on Computer Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: The rapid development of computer networking technology has provided new opportunities and challenges for physical education teaching. This paper is based on computer networking technology and designs a comprehensive sports teaching system aimed at providing a more comprehensive, personalized, and interactive sports teaching experience. The system design includes a three-tier architecture pattern, ASP technology, database access technology, and ACTIVEX programming technology, among other related techniques. In terms of hardware design, motion capture sensing devices and dual control power supplies were designed. In terms of software design, a big data sports-assisted teaching module and a related big data teaching-assisted resource library were developed. Through system testing, the functionality, performance, and stability of the system were verified. The research results indicate that the sports teaching system based on computer networking technology has broad application prospects and can provide richer and more effective teaching tools and resources for physical education. Further research can optimize the system's functionality, enhance user experience, and promote continuous improvement in teaching effectiveness.

articleTitle: Digital Asset Valuation Method for Online Games Based on Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: Data has become a key production factor in the era of the digital economy, and promoting data assetization is a need for market development. With the rapid development of the mobile game market in recent years, the demand for game account transactions has increased. A reasonable valuation and pricing for the game account can facilitate the transaction between buyers and sellers on the one hand and save the time of price gaming between the two sides. Therefore, this paper takes an online game account as the research object. Proposes a machine learning algorithm-based online game account valuation scheme. The experiments show that the most critical evaluation indicator of the model, the decision coefficient reaches 0.8811, which can meet the requirements of an actual valuation scenario.

articleTitle: Deep Video-Denoising Based on Multi-Scale Feature Extraction and Fusion Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of deep learning methods has provided new ideas and methods for video denoising. In this paper, a deep video denoising model based on multi-scale feature extraction and fusion mechanism is proposed. The model extracts features from the original and down-sampled input video images separately, fuses the extracted multi-scale feature maps, and generates the final video denoising results on this basis. Compared with the existing algorithm, the proposed method exhibits better video denoising performance while achieving faster computation speed, which has promising application prospects.

Author Keywords: multi-scale feature extraction and fusion mechanism

articleTitle: Fragmented Intelligence Data Management Based on Digital Object Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: Fragmented intelligence data is an important piece of information in intelligence research. In actual business, it presents the characteristics of large data volume, various types, different structures, and wide sources and coverage. Under the traditional data management mode, the intelligence business scene data is highly correlated and coupled, but due to the different structure and storage methods of the data, it is difficult to achieve overall deployment, aggregation and sharing of multi-source heterogeneous and fragmented intelligence data. Aiming at these problems, a fragmented intelligence management method based on data objects is proposed, and the digital object system and related technologies are used to realize the view unification, fusion and on-demand sharing of multi-source heterogeneous fragmented intelligence data. An effective solution is provided for the management of multi-source heterogeneous intelligence data resources under the collaborative intelligence research work mode.

articleTitle: Development and Situation Analysis of Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: Taking technology patents related to knowledge graph included in PSS as research samples, this paper conducts quantitative analysis on the trend of annual application, distribution of IPC, distribution of key technologies, and distribution of application fields. The results show that the number of technology patents related to knowledge graph will continue to increase, and a large number of related technologies have been applied to data processing systems. Also, the technical hotspots and hot fields of knowledge graph are clarified, and the technology frontiers of knowledge graph in the future are pointed out.

articleTitle: Multi-View Clustering of Dual Graph Non-Negative Matrices Factorization with Diversity Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: Non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) has become a hot-spot of extensive research due to its ability to achieve dimensional reduction, but the existing research still has limitations: 1) they only utilize information about the consistency of the data while ignore information about the diversity due to the multifaceted collection of data. 2) They capture only the local structure of the data, while useful information that can facilitate the clustering task is still present in the feature manifold. To alleviate the above problems, we propose multi-view clustering of dual graph non-negative matrices factorization with diversity constraints (MVC-DGNMF). Specifically, diversity constraints are utilized to capture diversity information between views. Then, the data and feature manifold are utilized to extract internal structural information, taking diversity into account. Finally, an algorithm for efficient iterative optimization is solved based on the model in this paper. Experiments demonstrate that the approach in this paper attains better performance compared to the excellent multi-view clustering methods.

articleTitle: An Application of Improving the Sparrow Search Algorithm in Optimizing Wireless Sensor Network Coverage
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: The problem of insufficient coverage in random deployment of nodes in wireless sensor networks, This article proposes an optimized Sparrow Search Algorithm (TCSSA). The TENT chaotic mapping theory was introduced during the population initialization phase to overcome the randomness of node deployment and promote the rapid diffusion of nodes during the initialization phase. Introducing the Cauchy mutation factor to perturb the deployment of nodes, enhance the speed of node movement, and avoid node clustering. Improvement algorithms(TCSSA) increased by 1.71<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>and 2.63<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>in 20 nodes and 30 nodes within the monitoring area of 100M*100M, respectively. Improvement algorithms(TCSSA) can effectively improve the network coverage of wireless sensors and have good practicality.

articleTitle: Prediction of Equipment Consumption Based on Partial Least Squares Regression and Markov Chain Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: The influencing factors of the demand of equipd equipment are analyzed, and the prediction model of equiped equipment consumption with partial least squares regression and Markov chain is proposed. Firstly, the preliminary prediction is carried out by using partial least squares regression, the prediction error states are divided, the state transfer probability matrix is established, and the prediction results are corrected by using the Markov chain model. The results show that the partial least squares regression and Markov chain model, can predict the demand for equipd equipment more accurately.

articleTitle: Research on Transmission Relationship of Grid Green Development Assessment Indicators Based on Improved PageRank ISM Big Data Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: Green development is the internal requirement for achieving carbon peak and carbon neutrality, implementing the new development concept, building a Dual circulation, and promoting high-quality development. It is an important path to respond to the major strategic decisions made by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China in coordinating domestic and international situations. In order to ensure the green development of power grid enterprises, the relationship between green development indicator systems of power grid enterprises driven by Big data should be established. This paper aims at the existing green development indicator system in Fujian Province. First, through Big data analysis, based on the ISM model, we build a Relational model for the conduction between indicators. Then, based on the constructed directed graph of the conduction relationship between indicators, we use the improved PageRank algorithm to calculate the importance of each indicator, and rank the importance of the indicators based on this, so that power grid enterprises can better rationalize the conduction relationship between indicators.

articleTitle: A Study on the Spatial Distribution of Tourist Attractions above 3A Level in Hangzhou Based on POI Extraction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: [Objective] To study the spatial distribution status and laws of tourist attractions above 3A level in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, through Big data, so as to provide reference for the planning and development of tourist attractions in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province. [ Method] Firstly, 74 tourist attractions above 3A level were captured using POI capture technology; Secondly, the spatial distribution characteristics of tourist attractions above 3A level in Hangzhou are studied by using the nearest neighbor index and Kernel density estimation in combination with various basic geographical data and by means of GIS analysis. [ Conclusion] (1) The overall clustering distribution of tourist attractions above 3A level in Hangzhou is significant, with significant spatial autocorrelation; (2) 72.24% of rural recreational activities are distributed within a range of 100km from the city center; (3) The estimated distribution density shows that scenic spots above 3A level are concentrated and distributed in contiguous areas in the central and eastern regions, while they are scattered in the western regions.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Fusion Method of Equipment Account Data of Pumped Storage Power Station
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of data fusion processing of equipment account of pumped storage power station, and avoid problems such as large energy consumption, data attribute conflict, data null value, poor data redundancy elimination effect caused by too long fusion period, the research on intelligent data fusion method of equipment account of pumped storage power station was carried out. First, collect the equipment account data of pumped storage power station in an all-round and multi-dimensional manner. Second, preprocess the collected equipment account data conflicts to reduce data noise and improve the quality of equipment account data. On this basis, the equipment account data of the pumped storage power station is intelligently fused. Experimental analysis shows that after the application of the new method, the data surplus ratio is always small, the data fusion efficiency has been significantly improved, and the goal of effective fusion of account data attributes and elimination of redundant data has been achieved.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a College Student Employment Information System Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: With the rapid development of big data technology and the increasingly severe employment situation of college students, it is crucial to build a college student employment information system based on big data technology. This article aims to design and implement such a system to provide comprehensive management and effective utilization of employment information for college students. To achieve this goal, this research focuses on the following key technologies: web crawler design, data preprocessing, content similarity based recommendation, model-based collaborative filtering and hybrid recommendation algorithm. Through the research and practice of this article, we hope to build an efficient, accurate, and personalized employment information system for college students, providing better employment services and support for students, and providing more convenient and accurate recruitment channels for employers, promoting the improvement of the employment rate of college graduates.

articleTitle: Assessing Word Difficulty: A Mapping Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: This paper presents a word difficulty mapping method that utilizes three indicators: Average Number of Times, Word Frequency Score, and Word Difficulty Score, to map the difficulty of words. The effectiveness of this method is demonstrated using the EERIE as a case study. To predict the Average Number of Times, a Refined Simulated Annealing Model, which combines K-Dimension Tree, is employed. Subsequently, word difficulty is mapped using K-Means cluster analysis. The results indicate a strong correlation between the Average Number of Times, Frequency Score of The Word, Difficulty Score of The Word and word difficulty, highlighting the efficacy of the proposed word difficulty mapping method.

articleTitle: Research on Interaction Design of Snow Shan Shui Game Based on VR Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: This paper proposes a research on Interaction design of snow Shan shui game based on VR technology. First of all, it summarizes the virtual reality (VR) technology and its application in game design, focusing on the analysis of the manifestation of snow Shan shui and its use in game design. This paper deeply studies the VR rendering technology of snow Shan shui, including the system requirements and specification definition, the 3D modeling technology of snow Shan shui, the development of rendering algorithm and calculation formula, and the technical realization of light and texture simulation. The article also studies the Interaction design of VR games, discusses in detail the design and implementation of user interaction mode, the design and implementation of interaction awareness algorithm, and the technical strategy of UI/UX design. In addition, the article also explores the key stages of system implementation and testing, including programming and integration of game systems, design and execution of functional and non functional tests, evaluation and optimization of system performance, as well as user testing and feedback collection <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>.

articleTitle: Forecasting Model of Fishery Import and Export Trade Data Using Deep Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: Fisheries import and export trade is an important component of agricultural trade and has a significant impact on national economic growth. Through the forecast of the development of fishery import and export trade, it can provide reference for the fishery management department to formulate reasonable policies and regulations to promote the sustainable development of fishery. This paper uses the import and export trade amount data in the China Fishery Statistical Yearbook as the experimental sample. In order to solve the characteristics of overfitting and insufficient generalization ability that are prone to occur in few-shot prediction, the idea of weighted moving average method is introduced for data enhancement. Through experimental simulation, optimizing the hyperparameters of the Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Recurrent Neural Network (BiLSTM) to build a predictive model. Input the expanded samples into the trained BiLSTM prediction model to predict the import and export trade data of fishery aquatic products. Experimental results show that this model has higher prediction accuracy and stability than commonly used models such as Gated Recurrent Units (GRU), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Back-propagation (BP) neural network.

articleTitle: A hybrid study of DE and ABC algorithms with self-adaptive parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: In order to make full use of the complementary advantages of artificial bee colony algorithm and differential evolution algorithm to solve various optimization problems, this paper proposes to introduce a difference operator with adaptive parameters into the employed bee and onlooker bee stage of artificial bee colony algorithm, the two algorithms are mixed to form sABChDE algorithm, and the evolution ratio is used to adjust the use probability of both. In order to further enhance the exploitation ability of the algorithm, the roulette strategy is replaced by the improved elite solution strategy in the onlooker bee stage. The results of comparison experiments on CEC2014 benchmark function show that sABChDE algorithm achieves better precision in solving different problems, indicating that the algorithm realizes complementary advantages through adaptive mixing, and improves the universality and robustness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on sky survey mission planning for multi-objective optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: Sky survey observations are an important direction for future international astronomical research. The China Space Station Telescope (CSST) will be launched in the near future, its sky survey mission requires 17,500 deg2 of sky survey observation and 400 deg2 of deep field observation to be completed within ten years, which is characterized by large scale, long duration and complex constraints, making the mission planning difficult. In order to solve the mission planning problem of CSST, this paper constructs a mission planning model based on the on-orbit operation mode, constraints and scientific targets of the China Space Station Telescope, with the objectives of shortest total time of sky survey mission, lowest energy consumption and largest priority of the observed sky area. A phased sky survey mission planning algorithm is designed to optimally solve the sky survey mission planning problem, simulation results demonstrate that the mission planning algorithm is able to complete the telescope's sky survey observation mission one year ahead of schedule.

articleTitle: YOLOv5s-FBG: A Small Object Detection Method in Complex Road Background
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: We propose an enhanced object detection algorithm, YOLOv5s-FBG, to address the challenges associated with false detections and missed detections caused by numerous small targets within complex road backgrounds. Firstly, we introduce a shallow detection layer dedicated to detecting smaller targets, augmenting the original algorithm's three-scale detection to four-scale. This enhancement extends the algorithm's capacity to learn and recognize features of smaller targets. Secondly, inspired by the feature fusion concept of the Weighted Bidirectional Feature Pyramid Network (BiFPN), we introduce a modified version called de-weighted BiFPN. This innovation optimally harnesses deep, shallow, and original feature information, bolstering feature fusion while minimizing information loss during the convolution process, consequently elevating detection accuracy. Lastly, drawing inspiration from the principles of GhostNet, we refine the original Bottleneck architecture to reduce the network's size, parameters, and computational complexity while maintaining detection accuracy. Our experimental findings demonstrate that the refined algorithm, as presented in this paper, achieves a detection accuracy of 94.6% and 96.5% on two distinct datasets: the publicly available autonomous driving dataset KITTI and our self-made rider helmet dataset, Helmet. When compared to the original algorithm, the enhanced algorithm yields an improvement of 1.6% and 1.8% in detection accuracy, achieving detection speeds of 73 FPS and 69 FPS, respectively. This signifies excellent detection accuracy and real-time performance. Furthermore, in comparison to some mainstream object detection algorithms, the improved algorithm in this article exhibits notable advantages.

articleTitle: Data Imputation via Support Vector Regression with Hybrid Breeding Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Blockchain Technology and Applications (ICBTA)
abstract: Missing value is a common problem in real-world datasets and its imputation is crucial for data analyses. A major limitation of the accuracy of missing value imputation model, such as SVR-based model, is the appropriate selection of parameters, which can significantly affect the learning process and prediction accuracy of the model. To address the challenge, an imputation method based on SVR is proposed and the basic idea is to obtain the fittest parameters of SVR by hybrid breeding optimization (HBO) algorithm (SVR-HBO). Experimental results demonstrate that SVR-HBO has superior performance compared to other comparative algorithms.
